command: xmutil listapps; xbutil examine; for d in /sys/class/fpga_manager/*; do printf "\n%s\n" "$d"; for f in name state status firmware flags; do if test -f "$d/$f"; then printf "%s: " "$f"; cat "$d/$f"; fi; done; done; find /sys/kernel/config/device-tree /configfs/device-tree -maxdepth 3 -type f; ls -l /dev/dri /dev/uio*; ls -l /sys/bus/platform/drivers/zocl /sys/bus/platform/drivers/dpu*; cat /proc/iomem
